utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you decided where the repair drive should go?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet — I’m still checking which spot would be easiest for everyone to reach.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you pick the spot by tomorrow? I want to let people know soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can bring over my tools for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need fixed first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks, Gus. I think the main thing is the old gate by the drive; if you can take a look at that first, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll start with the old gate and see what’s going on. If I need anything extra, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—people have been dropping things off all morning. If you’re going, it looks like a good time to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear—I'm just thinking about timing and parking. I’ll probably wait until the rush dies down a bit.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good call—late afternoon should be much calmer, and parking’s usually easier then too. I’ll let you know if it starts clearing out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you head to the community center parking lot and check in with me by the east entrance?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll head over to the community center parking lot and check in with you at the east entrance.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m definitely spreading the word — the repair drive sounds like the kind of thing neighbors should show up for. If you want, I can invite a few more folks too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would mean a lot, Quinn. Thanks for helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll tell a few more neighbors today. We can make this repair drive feel like a real block effort.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help keep the repair drive organized and neighbor-friendly. What do you want to tackle first, Leo?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with the repair list and who can help. I’ll keep it simple and practical.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — let’s jot down the repairs first, then match each one with a neighbor who has the right tools or time. If you want, I can help sort them into urgent, easy, and wait-list items.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the details first—what exactly needs repairing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help if you tell me what’s on the list—I’m usually a bit late, but I’ll pitch in once I know what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane. I’m going to confirm the repair list first, then I’ll let you know exactly what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that—what time is the repair drive, and does it line up with the school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It starts at 3:30, so it should line up okay with school pickup. I’ll double-check the exact handoff details and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks—just let me know the handoff details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re still gathering a few more volunteers and sorting the tool list, but it’s coming together nicely.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Glad to hear it—if you hear where they still need help, pass it my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what time should I swing by?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you confirm what time you were thinking?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I was thinking around 6 pm — does that work?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s kind of you, Rey. Could you bring some gloves, a hammer, and maybe a few screws if you’ve got them?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can bring those.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll check our supply stash and see what we still need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep telling neighbors about the repair drive and let you know if anyone can help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring something by today. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We still need a few hands for sorting the donations and loading the truck. If you can drop by later, I’ll point you to the spot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can do that — I’ll drop by later and help sort and load. Just point me to the spot when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just bring any broken small appliances or tools you’ve got, and we’ll sort them out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I think I’ve got an old lamp and maybe a broken drill I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand or a tool if you need it for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll bring a small checklist and we can sort the tools first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — bring the checklist and I’ll pull together the basic tools we’ll need first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Amazing — could you spread the word to a few neighbors and let me know who’s free this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word to a few neighbors and check who’s free this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—want me to reach out and see who can pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please—could you ask around and see who’s available to help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll ask around and see who can help with the repair drive. I’ll let you know what I find soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Cleo, I’m getting the repair drive organized and I’d love your help. Do you want to handle sign-ups or outreach?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can handle the sign-ups. I’ll keep a neat list and make sure we don’t miss anyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thanks, Cleo — that’ll help a lot. I’ll take outreach and send folks your way as they reply.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces—has the repair drive started yet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet, but it should start soon. Are you planning to help out?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think so—if I can, I’d like to help out once it starts. I’ve been hearing about it second-hand, so I’m still catching up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help me figure out when we can drop off the supplies? I’m juggling school pickup, so I need a time that works around that.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah — what time window works best after school pickup? I can make a quick drop-off then.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re really willing to help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’m in. Just let me know what you need me to do.
